capabilities: Sync vault files two-way through Baidu Netdisk
Encrypt synced files with optional end-to-end encryption
Keep conflict copies when devices edit the same file
Pair devices by exporting and importing an encrypted configuration code
Trigger sync manually, on startup, on a schedule, or after edits
extras: Free and open source (MIT) with no paid tiers; the first device needs a Baidu Netdisk developer app and OAuth, while other devices can import a pairing code. E2EE v2 requires all synced devices on v1.1.0 or later.
problem: Syncing a vault across desktop and mobile usually requires paid subscriptions or self-hosted infrastructure, and mobile Git or WebDAV setups can be unreliable.

relations.evidence: bi-directional synchronization plugin for Obsidian via Baidu Netdisk

summary: Two-way sync plugin that connects Obsidian vaults across devices through Baidu Netdisk, with optional end-to-end encryption and conflict copies.
